thread:
elaine: Quick FYI — noticed ~8% of hourly aggregates for `eu_usage_agg` are missing for a 3h window starting ~2026-02-18T02:00Z. Looks like partition 12 in the ingest topic lagged and some events landed late.

mohit: ugh. any failure in the replayer?

elaine: No obvious replayer crash. Kafka consumer lag + a delayed compact job. The ingest watermark jumped so console routing skipped the late window.

samira: Can we run a targeted backfill for that 3h slice? Prefer not to kick a full reslice.

ryan: Yes — we have the targeted-replayer script. Dry-run first: `scripts/targeted-replayer --topic ingest-eu --start 2026-02-18T02:00Z --end 2026-02-18T05:00Z --dry-run`.

elaine: I ran dry-run and got ~120k events to reprocess. Estimated cost: ~0.9 compute-hours with concurrency=8.

mohit: Does the console estimator show that cost? The UI estimator has been underreporting small-window runs lately.

console-bot: FYI: Estimator v2 shows 1.1 compute-hours for the given window (includes kv-warmup). Link: https://console.redwood.internal/backfill/estimates/6865432100

samira: We should also add a temporary routing rule so live requests during the replay route to warm fallback model (latency-sensitive). Otherwise latency SLO might spike.

ryan: Proposed plan: 1) schedule targeted replayer with concurrency=6, 2) monitor per-route latency, 3) set priority lane throttle to 50% for non-critical tenants.

elaine: Can someone toggle the console flag? `console:backfill_priority_override=true`

mohit: I'll toggle the flag and watch the SLO dash. Give me 5m.

opsbot: @mohit changed `console:backfill_priority_override` from `false` to `true`

mohit: Flag set. Starting the replay now (no dry-run): `scripts/targeted-replayer --topic ingest-eu --start 2026-02-18T02:00Z --end 2026-02-18T05:00Z --concurrency 6 --commit`

elaine: Kicking off. Console shows job ID `tr-6865432100-1`. Watchlist: eu-agg-hours, kv-warmup, per-route latencies.

samira: I'll keep an eye on the aggregator dashboards and trigger a quick rollback if error rate > 0.5% or latency > 300ms.

ryan: Also add an ephemeral quota bump for the replayer service: `quotactl grant replayer-team 10cpu 30m --reason "targeted reprocess eu window"`. Otherwise preemption will stall.

opsbot: @ryan created quota grant 6865432100-QG (expires 2026-02-18T03:10Z)

elaine: Job started, ingest consumer offset is rewound. First batches look good. No duplicated aggregates yet; replayer marks idempotency token.

samira: Seeing slight tail in request latency on eu-facing routes, but within threshold.

mohit: Replayer progress: 40% complete. Current throughput ~4.2k events/s.

ryan: Note for postmortem: add console UX hint when watermark jumps (link from the estimator to the targeted-replayer dry-run).

elaine: Agreed. Also file a small console bug — estimator v1 mismatched kv-warmup cost. I'll create a ticket.

samira: 95% complete now. No regressions observed.

opsbot: Job `tr-6865432100-1` completed successfully. Processed 118,934 events in 12m.

elaine: Closing loop — aggregates reconciled, dashboard refreshed. Created follow-up: `ENGPLAT-1327` to improve estimator accuracy and add a one-click dry-run shortcut in the console.

ryan: Nice. Thanks all. :tada:

samira: Good ops.

mohit: LGTM.

elaine: marking thread done.
